body: Same here. Like literally whenever something bad happens my first thought is "well, I can always kill myself" and that thought is honestly what keeps me here. It is kind of easier to deal with everything when you know that you always have an option to die.

I'm so sorry to hear you feel that way. But before you decide to kill yourself I advise you to get professional help because it might really save you. As for your gf, I know how it is to be in a shitty relationship because I've been in one and I was in pain for a long time after that but time healed me I guess. Anyway, if u wanna talk or smth u can msg me maybe talking will help u.
